author: cairn
blurb: Organise recent captures: tag, link, and tidy notes.

definition.name: Tidy inbox
definition.description: Tags recent untagged notes and surfaces suggested connections.
definition.instructions: Scan the most recent notes that have no tags. For each, infer a sensible tag from the content (create the tag if needed) and apply it. If two or more notes clearly relate to each other, note the suggested link. Finish with a short summary note 'Tidy inbox — <date>' listing what was tagged and any connections found. Do not delete anything.
